inputs.description: The wallet address that will sign (0x...). Never a private key. Omit it when a walletToken is passed — the wallet is resolved from the token instead.

Ticker, up to 32 bytes.
https:// or ipfs:// logo.
Up to 2000 characters.
https:// links, up to 8.
Creator fee in basis points, 0 to 500. Required. 0 means 0%.
Optional buy at launch, in wei.
Seconds before trading opens, 0 to 2592000.
Agent-launched label. Default true.
https://github.com/owner/repo, optional.
Attribution tag for traffic measurement. Default "grok".

Optional https:// link back to your agent flow. The signing page shows it as a button after the transaction confirms, with ?tx=<hash>&status=confirmed added. Anything that is not an https:// URL is ignored.

A wallet token from /sign?connect=1: connect once, store the token, and pass it instead of from on every prepare call. The wallet is resolved from the token (signature-checked, 90-day expiry). When both are passed they must name the same wallet.

tools.description: Dry-run plan for paying any x402 endpoint from the other chain: fetch the 402, read the wallet's balances on Base and Robinhood Chain, and quote the Relay bridge for only the shortfall. tools.name: x402_cross_chain_pay
tools.title: Cross-chain x402 pay
tools.description: The executable package for paying any x402 endpoint from the other chain: the dry-run plan, the unsigned Relay bridge transactions (approve + deposit, shortfall only), and the EIP-3009 typed data to sign for the settlement. Returns unsigned transactions only — the agent signs the bridge steps on the origin chain, waits for the bridge to land, signs the typed data, and POSTs it to the product URL as an X-PAYMENT header. Never signs, never takes a private key.

tools.name: polypad_agent_chat
tools.title: Business agent chat
tools.description: Run a business agent chat completion through Polypad: send a system prompt and messages, get the assistant reply. Only allowlisted business API keys can call it — every call is metered as API usage. The model is fixed (gpt-4o-mini) and the caller never sees the OpenAI key. Prompt and reply content is never logged.

inputs.description: The system prompt for the business agent, 1 to 12000 characters.
Chat messages, oldest first. 1 to 20 messages; each content 1 to 12000 characters.
Sampling temperature. Default 0.7.
Max reply tokens, 1 to 2000. Default 600.

exampleArgs.systemPrompt: You are a helpful youth baseball sports agent.

messages.content: What should I work on to get recruited?

tools.exampleCurl: curl -X POST "https://polypad.family/api/agents/v2/agent-chat" -H "content-type: application/json" -d '{"systemPrompt":"You are a helpful youth baseball sports agent.","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"What should I work on to get recruited?"}]}'
tools.exampleMcp: curl -X POST "https://polypad.family/api/mcp" -H "content-type: application/json" -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"polypad_agent_chat","arguments":{"systemPrompt":"You are a helpful youth baseball sports agent.","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"What should I work on to get recruited?"}]}}}'
